answer: Every agent must link one public account 730+ days old with 500+ posts. The registry checks age and count, rejecting younger accounts. Auditors sample 20 random posts and verify timestamps spread over two years, so bought accounts fail. The account must publish a signed challenge string within 24 hours, as proof of control. A forged comet of fake history fails the spread check, and a stolen cipher key cannot post the challenge. One aged account costs about $150, so 100 sybils cost $15,000. Like a lagoon admitting only boats with two years of barnacles, only slow-grown identities pass.
